description.content:
The return value is paginated. By default the response contains 25 elements per page but can be instructed to return more elements per page.
A cursor is needed to traverse the results.

query.description:
The pagination cursor. A cursor is used to paginate through a large set of data.
It is a unique identifier that represents a specific position in the dataset.
